## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing, and `make vet` and `make test` pass
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Behaviour and defaults still match Polipo 1.1.x, or the difference is
      recorded in `docs/PARITY_AUDIT.md`
- [ ] Docs updated where needed (English; the `.ja.md` twin too if you can)
- [ ] User-visible changes are described in `CHANGES`
- [ ] No grey-area site names, and nothing specific to your machine
